blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The one-time Abatement Program for Micro Taxpayers of the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) reported 6,234 applications in the first two months of implementation, as of Sept. 18, with 5,000 of them already approved. According to a BIR statement issued on Tuesday, the approved applications covered ₱84.5 million in tax liabilities and penalties, while ₱24.82 million in abatement fees had been paid. “Availment gained momentum following President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.’s mention of the program in his State of the Nation Address and intensified information campaigns by our Revenue Regions. Upon the direction of Finance Secretary Frederick Go, […]...
